5
Which statement about atoms or ions is correct?
A
The mass number of an atom is the total number of nucleons and protons.
The electronic configuration of an aluminium ion, Al3+, is 2,8,3.
B
C
Hydrogen is the only atom that has an incomplete first electron shell.
D
Most of the volume of an atom is taken up by its nucleus.
